items.description: Whether the workflow should key requests directly by BreakKey or accept an external request identifier was unclear.
items.resolution: The black-box command boundary uses caller-supplied requestId. Implementations may associate it with BreakKey internally, but exported history must preserve requestId exactly.

items.description: Whether self-approval is ever permitted was unclear.
items.resolution: It is never permitted. A checker identity equal to the durable proposer identity cannot create an approved or rejected terminal entry.

items.description: The outcome of simultaneous approve and reject commands was unspecified.
items.resolution: Both commands must complete through declared adapter outcomes, but durable history must contain exactly one recognized final decision for the request.

items.description: The audit export shape and actor field names were not specified.
items.resolution: Export is JSON: either an array or an object with entries. Entries expose requestId (or a documented equivalent), action/eventType/status, proposer or checker identity, contiguous 1-based sequence, previousHash, and a lowercase SHA-256 hash over canonical JSON with recursively sorted keys.

items.description: Whether evidence may appear in operational telemetry was unclear.
items.resolution: Evidence may be stored in durable audit state but must not be emitted in logs or telemetry. Account and amount values must not appear in the export either.
